question: What is the extent of accomplishment gained by reciting this mantra one hundred thousand times?
premises: The mantra is recited one hundred thousand times.
The recitation is performed on earth.
The rhetorical question implies no limit to accomplishment.
inference: Reciting this mantra one hundred thousand times accomplishes everything on earth.
plain_english: By reciting this mantra one hundred thousand times, what is not accomplished on earth?
